name: FicWeave
tagline: An AI writing workspace for multi-chapter fanfiction and original stories.
description: FicWeave is an AI writing workspace for multi-chapter fanfiction and original stories. The first chapter can be read without an account. The free plan includes the first chapter, 3 starter continuations (once), and 1 editable story. Paid plans are Pro $7.99/month (100 Credits, up to 20 editable stories), Pro+ $14.99/month (200 Credits, up to 50 editable stories), and Max $24.99/month (400 Credits, up to 100 editable stories). Paid plans include long-term, editable Story Memory. Credits refresh each subscription month and do not roll over. One-time Credit Packs are no longer sold. A saved standard continuation uses 1 Credit; Story Memory updates use no Credits.
